description: This file implements a Qdrant vector store class with methods for initialization, index management, point upsertion, deletion, and search, utilizing the Qdrant REST client and handling URL parsing, collection configuration, and indexing metadata.

classes.name: QdrantVectorStore
classes.description: A class implementing a vector store interface using Qdrant, supporting collection management, point upsert, search, and index status tracking.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the QdrantVectorStore with workspace path, server URL, vector size, and optional API key, setting up the client and collection name.

methods.name: parseQdrantUrl
methods.description: Parses and normalizes the input URL for Qdrant server, handling various formats and defaults.

methods.name: parseHostname
methods.description: Handles hostname-only inputs, adding protocol prefix as needed.

methods.name: getCollectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the collection from Qdrant.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Creates or verifies the collection, recreating it if vector dimension mismatches, and sets up payload indexes.

methods.name: _recreateCollectionWithNewDimension
methods.description: Deletes and recreates the collection with a new vector dimension if needed, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: _createPayloadIndexes
methods.description: Creates payload indexes for filtering, handling errors if indexes already exist.

methods.name: upsertPoints
methods.description: Upserts points into the collection, processing filePath into pathSegments.

methods.name: isPayloadValid
methods.description: Validates if a payload contains required keys.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a vector similarity search with optional directory filtering and score thresholds.

methods.name: deletePointsByFilePath
methods.description: Deletes points associated with a specific file path.

methods.name: deletePointsByMultipleFilePaths
methods.description: Deletes points for multiple file paths, matching path segments.

methods.name: clearCollection
methods.description: Removes all points from the collection.

methods.name: hasIndexedData
methods.description: Checks if the collection has indexed points and indexing completion marker.

methods.name: markIndexingComplete
methods.description: Marks indexing as complete by inserting a metadata point.

methods.name: markIndexingIncomplete
methods.description: Marks indexing as incomplete, indicating work in progress.
